title: 第6章 绝对不会再犯贱
slug: 帝少爆宠娇妻霸上瘾全本免费-帝少爆宠娇妻霸上瘾最新章节列表
content_zh:
这点药效对他来说还不足以迷倒他，冷冽的眸光落在眼前的小嫩芽儿身上。
这丫头很聪明，兜个圈子就把话给套出来了。
估计是因为年纪小，还不懂怎么隐藏自己的情绪。
他似乎在这丫头脸上看到了几分幸灾乐祸？
那双灵动不染尘埃的眸子，脆亮得像星辰般耀眼，又狡黠的像只小狐狸。
他转身摁下墙上的警报铃，很快外头的保镖快速涌了进来。
“把她给我扔到林子里喂狼！”慕非池指着韩婉灵冷声命令道。
“是！少帅！”
“不……少帅我没有……这不是我做的……是这个贱丫头诬陷我！”
算计了慕非池，韩婉灵肯定不会傻到主动承认。
承认，那就等于死！
可一听到林子里的狼群，她也慌了，吓得直接跪回地上去了！
“我又不认识你，近日无冤往日无仇，诬陷你做什么？”
云曦看着被保镖拉开的落地窗，生怕那头雪豹冲进来。
她本来没打算搅和，之所以开口套她话，就是要在慕非池面前攒个插话权，保她一命。
韩婉灵要是现在就喂狼了，以后韩家可就没好戏看了。
这一世，她要把主动权掌控在自己手里！
把她曾经受过的苦，十倍的还给他们！
慕非池在她眼底看到了不合年纪的狠辣，有些意外又有些好奇。
“少帅，真的不是我做的！是她，是她诬陷我！放眼整个京都，哪个女人不喜欢你仰慕你？肯定是这个贱人勾引你不成，故意栽赃到我身上来的！”

韩婉灵费了好大劲才混进基地，跟本不知道云曦是怎么出现在这里的。
要是知道，估计就不会这么叫嚣了。
没有人会为了勾引少帅，用命去跟狼群拼死一搏。
贼喊捉贼的把戏，想慕非池这里行不通。
云曦笑着开口：“少帅，钝刀割肉，更能一雪今日之耻！”
“你……你你想割我的肉！贱人！你有什么资格在少帅面前指手画脚！分明就是你栽赃陷害我！”
说这话的时候，韩婉灵恶狠狠的瞪着云曦，怨毒的眼神恨不得从她身上瞪出几个窟窿来。
云曦知道慕非池听得懂自己这话的意思，淡笑着不解释。
她这会儿算是想起来了，上辈子韩婉灵就是因为给慕非池下药药量过度导致昏迷，以至于慕非池醒来后第一个就对韩家下手。
为了爬上慕非池的床，韩婉灵也是挺拼命的，拼的还是整个韩家人的命。
而这个被称为帝国少帅的男人，报复起人的手段来更是前无古人后无来者，堪称够绝的。
他利用韩氏内部的敌对势力，一点点磨掉韩家的势力财力，最后把人逼到走投无路。
韩婉灵跟乔希敏趁机挪空了南区工程项目资金，联手栽赃到她头上！
为了填补集团内部财务危机，她才会拼了命的研究新产品，甚至不惜拿自己做实验！
经历过上一世韩耀天的背叛，重活这一世，她绝对不会再犯贱！
她不会让他们死得太轻易。
活着，才能好好承受这个世界最肮脏的罪孽和痛苦。
慕非池一拂手，暗眸迸射出森冷寒光：“把她给我扔出基地，告诉韩荣，他女儿得罪我了！还有，以后再放一个无关紧要的人进来，让你们队长提头来见！”
“是！”保镖直接把瘫软的韩婉灵架了出去。
客厅再度安静下来。

云曦扫了眼药效发作的男人，下意识的就想跑！
那药虽然提纯不高，这个年代还没有媚药这种称呼，迷药实际可以说是媚药的雏形了。
就算他是铁打的军人，药效发作的时候也是挨不住的！
这里就她一个女人，她要是不跑，留下来遭殃的肯定是她！

content_en:
The effect of this medicine was not enough to fascinate him, so his cold eyes fell on the little bud in front of him.
This girl is very smart, and she figured it out in a roundabout way.
It's probably because I'm young and don't know how to hide my emotions.
He seemed to see a bit of schadenfreude on this girl's face?
Those smart and dust-free eyes were as bright as stars and as cunning as a little fox.
He turned around and pressed the alarm bell on the wall, and soon the bodyguards from outside rushed in.
"Throw her into the forest to feed the wolves!" Mu Feichi pointed at Han Wanling and ordered coldly.
"Yes! Young Marshal!"
"No...Young Marshal, I didn't...I didn't do this...it was this bitch who framed me!"
After plotting against Mu Feichi, Han Wanling would definitely not be stupid enough to admit it.
Admit it, it is equal to death!
But when she heard the wolves in the forest, she panicked and fell to her knees on the ground in fear!
"I don't know you. I have no grievances these days and no enmities in the past. Why are you framed for this?"
Yun Xi looked at the floor-to-ceiling window that was opened by the bodyguard, fearing that the snow leopard would rush in.
She had no intention of causing trouble, and the reason why she started talking to her was to gain the right to intervene in front of Mu Feichi and save her life.
If Han Wanling feeds the wolves now, there will be no good for the Han family in the future.
In this life, she wants to take the initiative in her own hands!
Give them back ten times the suffering she has suffered!
Mu Feichi saw the ruthlessness in her eyes that was inappropriate for her age, and was a little surprised and curious.
"Young Marshal, I really didn't do it! It was her, she framed me! Looking at the entire Kyoto, which woman doesn't like you and admire you? This bitch must have failed to seduce you and deliberately framed me!"
Han Wanling spent a lot of effort to sneak into the base, and she didn't know how Yun Xi appeared here.
If I had known, I probably wouldn't have made such a fuss.
No one would risk their lives against the wolves just to seduce the young commander.
The thief shouted that the trick to catch the thief would not work here in Mufeichi.
Yun Xi smiled and said: "Young Marshal, cutting flesh with a blunt knife can avenge today's shame!"
"You...you want to cut my flesh off! Bitch! What qualifications do you have to point fingers in front of the young marshal! It's obviously you who framed me!"
When she said this, Han Wanling glared at Yun Xi fiercely, her hateful eyes wishing to poke holes in her body.
Yun Xi knew that Mu Feichi understood the meaning of her words and smiled lightly without explaining.
She finally remembered that in her previous life, Han Wanling drugged Mu Feichi too much and caused coma. Mu Feichi was the first to attack the Han family after waking up.
In order to climb into Mu Feichi's bed, Han Wanling worked very hard, and she fought hard for the lives of the entire Han family.
And this man, who was known as the Young Marshal of the Empire, had an unprecedented way of retaliating against others. He was truly unparalleled.
He took advantage of the hostile forces within the Han family to chip away at the Han family's power and financial resources, and finally forced people into desperation.
Han Wanling and Qiao Ximin took the opportunity to divert funds from the southern district project and jointly framed her!
In order to make up for the financial crisis within the group, she would research new products desperately, even experimenting on herself!
After experiencing Han Yaotian's betrayal in her previous life, she would never do anything mean again in this life!
She wouldn't let them die too easily.
Only by living can we bear the most filthy sins and pains in this world.
Mu Feichi waved his hand, and his dark eyes shot out with a cold light: "Throw her out of the base and tell Han Rong that his daughter has offended me! Also, if you let an unimportant person in in the future, let your captain come to see you!"
"Yes!" The bodyguard directly carried the limp Han Wanling out.
The living room became quiet again.
Yun Xi glanced at the man who was taking effect from the medicine, and subconsciously wanted to run away!
Although the medicine is not highly purified, in this era it is stillThere is no such name as aphrodisiac. In fact, it can be said that the drug is the prototype of aphrodisiac.
Even if he is a tough soldier, he still can't stand it when the medicine takes effect!
She is the only woman here. If she doesn't run away, she will definitely be the one left to suffer!
